message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, or a holiday that is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend, giving you a three‑day break.)

| Long weekend | Holiday(s) | Dates (2023) | Notes |
|--------------|------------|--------------|-------|
| **New Year’s** | New Year’s Day (observed) | **Jan 1 (Sun) – Jan 3 (Mon)** | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so the day off was observed on Monday, Jan 2. |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Family Day | **Feb 18 (Sat) – Feb 20 (Mon)** | Family Day was on Monday, Feb 20. |
| **Good Friday** | Good Friday | **Apr 7 (Fri) – Apr 9 (Sun)** | Good Friday itself is the holiday. |
| **Victoria Day** | Victoria Day | **May 20 (Sat) – May 22 (Mon)** | Victoria Day was on Monday, May 22. |
| **Canada Day** | Canada Day (observed) | **Jul 1 (Sat) – Jul 3 (Mon)** | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so the day off was observed on Monday, Jul 3. |
| **Labour Day** | Labour Day | **Sep 2 (Sat) – Sep 4 (Mon)** | Labour Day was on Monday, Sep 4. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Thanksgiving | **Oct 7 (Sat) – Oct 9 (Mon)** | Thanksgiving was on Monday, Oct 9. |
| **Remembrance Day** (observed) | Remembrance Day | **Nov 11 (Sat) – Nov 13 (Mon)** | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday, so the day off was observed on Monday, Nov 13. |
| **Christmas** | Christmas Day | **Dec 23 (Sat) – Dec 25 (Mon)** | Christmas Day was on Monday, Dec 25. |

### Quick‑look summary

| Month | Long weekend dates | Holiday(s) |
|-------|--------------------|------------|
| Jan | Jan 1–3 | New Year’s Day (observed) |
| Feb | Feb 18–20 | Family Day |
| Apr | Apr 7–9 | Good Friday |
| May | May 20–22 | Victoria Day |
| Jul | Jul 1–3 | Canada Day (observed) |
| Sep | Sep 2–4 | Labour Day |
| Oct | Oct 7–9 | Thanksgiving |
| Nov | Nov 11–13 | Remembrance Day (observed) |
| Dec | Dec 23–25 | Christmas Day |

> **Pro‑tip for your app** – If you want to support all provinces, remember that some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, Family Day in other provinces, etc.). You can add those as optional filters.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app, or let me know if you’d like the data in a different format (JSON, CSV, etc.).
